name: Tobias
personality: Hearty, forgetful veteran who loves drink, battle, singing and company.
story: A decorated commander who has served the Saraminian crown since King Sergio's reign; Queen Theodora calls him 'Boss'. He joins automatically on Theodora's route only, and his A support with Theodora unlocks in Part 3.

personalSkill.name: Power Arts
personalSkill.effect: Atk+3 when attacking with a combat art. Lv20: All-Out Attack (30% chance of 1.3x damage); Lv35: All-Out Attack+ (1.5x).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics B; KeenGamer A (combat arts specialist). Reddit: Light Cavalry → Cataphract praised as an exceptional physical tank; axe Hit suffers in Part III (confirmed): The Eternal's Axe Hit +10 answers it.

build.role: Arts front-liner on axes and gauntlets, second wall
build.part1Target: Warrior (Attack, Get Back and Regroup mastered)
build.notes: Pugilist and Brigand stay for their masteries (Attack, Get Back; Regroup). He sits Ch 8 to 9 (dungeon parties, Arena) and returns in Ch 10 as a Warrior with Zarcone's refined Hammer. Warrior's Axe Hit +5, Practiced Art and Battleblade Strike (Dex +2 a fight) fix his Hit. Warrior already trains Sword, Axe and Gauntlet, The Eternal's three S ranks: he stays Warrior to Section 3 and takes The Eternal in Section 4 (Str +30 growth, Axe Hit +10, Divine Might Str +10). Troy holds The Godhand. Undead: Theodora's Ch 6 Cleansing Blade, refined +3.

guide.role: Arts front-liner on axes and gauntlets, second wall
guide.summary: The Fortress's art striker and second wall, the army's Hammer, and The Eternal in Part III. Every swing is a combat art: Power Arts (Atk +3), [[ability:All-Out Attack]] and [[ability:Practiced Art]] all key off arts. Open with Battleblade Strike for Dex, then Hammer the armor next to Theodora.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: Battleblade Strike on the Da Mina Axe first (Dex +2 a fight), Hammer on armor. Enemy phase: hold the second choke beside Theodora on the Da Mina Sword (Wt 4, not the axe's 10), Bonaventure adjacent (Def +3). Part III: Cleansing Blade +3 on undead. Under Hit 70 in the forecast, switch to gauntlets.
keys: Sit him Ch 8 to 9: dungeon parties and Arena Warrior seats bank Sword, Axe and Gauntlet B.
Attack with an art every swing: Power Arts +3, All-Out Attack x1.3 to x1.5 (30%).
Take [[class:Pugilist]] at Lv 20, then [[class:Brigand]] in Ch 8 once Attack, Get Back shows.
Take Zarcone's [[item:Hammer]] in Ch 10 week 1 (+1; +2 at Ch 12): armor only, Wt 20.
Open each map with Battleblade Strike: Dex +2 a fight (max +10) before Hammer swings.
Equip the [[item:Conflagrant Gem]] (Ch 7) from Ch 8: arts Hit +20 (30%).
Push Sword, Axe and Gauntlet to S by Section 4: Arena Warrior seat from Section 2.
watch: Hit: Hammer 60, Da Mina Axe 65 + arts Hit +10; Spike +10, Warrior +5, Practiced Art +10, Gem +20 (30%). Under 70, bring Bonaventure.
Spd: 25 growth (35 in Pugilist, 25 in Warrior, 35 in The Eternal). Da Mina Sword (Wt 4) on enemy phase vs fast foes.
Weight: Da Mina Axe 10 + Gem 5 = 15, extra 5 (budget 6); Da Mina Sword 4 + 5 = 9. Hammer 20 + Gem 5 = 25: no follow-ups; armor only.
Inventory: Warrior is 6/6 (Da Mina Axe, Hammer, Da Mina Sword, Da Mina Gauntlets, Conflagrant Gem, Elixir).
Res: 20 growth, +0 flat in The Eternal. On mage maps end beside Sirocco (Barrier) or Ninae (Spirits' Guidance).
Part III weight: Zalmoxis 10 + Conflagrant Gem 5 = 15, extra 5 (budget 6); Mallet 19; Da Mina Gauntlets 9. Gem off first.

routeNotes.note: Theodora, Bonaventure, Sofia, Lilian, Lysander, Loretta and Ultand in this army. Meal seat: Theodora + Tobias + Bonaventure; Sofia takes the third seat once that pair is done.

Fifth carrier: [[battalion:Rookie Soldiers]] (Str +2) from Ch 6; no Authority seat, so E-tier only?. If fewer battalions deploy, the bench (Simon) drops first, then Lilian, then him. Skip Power-Arts Order (Authority A): Arena seats bench first.

decisions.pick: Pugilist at Lv 20 (Attack, Get Back), Brigand in Ch 8 (Regroup)
decisions.why: Both masteries stay in his slots to Part III: Avo +10 on every art and Avo +20 after a miss. Ranks alone wouldn't justify them, since Arena Warrior covers Sword, Axe and Gauntlet to B.
decisions.else: Masteries slow: take Warrior at Lv 35 anyway and finish them later

decisions.pick: Warrior at Lv 35 with Axe, Sword and Gauntlet B
decisions.why: Warrior adds Axe Hit +5 and Practiced Art (arts Hit +10) to the unit that misses most, plus Str 80 growth. Dreadnought's Hit bonus works only on enemy phase, with Res 10 growth and Mov 4.

decisions.topic: Stay infantry: The Eternal, not Cataphract or Castle Knight
decisions.pick: Warrior → The Eternal; the Fortress's player-phase finisher
decisions.why: Power Arts fires only on his own art swings; The Eternal pays it (Arts +3, Axe Hit +10, Str 90). Nydine holds the cavalry-armor seat, Centurio the infantry one; three Fortress walls already tank enemy phase.
decisions.else: Want Reddit's tank pick: Cataphract → Great Knight (Mov 6, Pavise), but spears hit him effective and Breza and Drake bar cavalry

decisions.topic: Take The Eternal; Troy holds The Godhand
decisions.pick: Warrior through Section 3, The Eternal in Section 4 (Scales of Judgement)
decisions.why: Warrior already trains Sword, Axe and Gauntlet, The Eternal's three S ranks. It adds Str +30 growth, Axe Hit +10 and Divine Might (Str +10) to every art. Troy has the Brawling and White boons The Godhand wants.

decisions.topic: Carry a Cleansing Blade in Part III
decisions.pick: Theodora's Ch 6 copy from storage, refined +3
decisions.why: Warrior and The Eternal hold swords, so the blade strips the Underworld Boon on his own swing and trains Sword S; Wrath Strike (Hit +10) lands it. He no longer has to stay within 2 of Eshmel.
decisions.else: Blade not refined yet: fight within 2 of Eshmel
